functional_form_guess: predict class_2 if x4^2 - 0.25 > 1.85*|x2*x5|, else class_1 if x2*x5 > 0, else class_0
rationale: All ten examples fit the rule. Idx 5 is class 2 with x4^2 of about 2.9 despite |x2*x5| of about 1.12, while idx 7 has x2*x5 of about 1.64 but x4^2 of only about 1.12 and is class 1.
